name: GA_Jailbreak_Benchmark
description:
GA Jailbreak Benchmark
	

A curated benchmark of 2,795 synthetic jailbreak attempts and safety prompts generated with the General Analysis Adversary Pipeline. Each record pairs a scenario with a user request designed either to violate (label 1) or comply with (label 0) one of our safety policies. Prompts cover multilingual, multi-format, and policy-specific adversarial strategies intended to stress-test guardrails and downstream models.

reputation: Used by safety researchers and red-teaming teams to evaluate model robustness to jailbreak attempts; moderately adopted in the safety community.
